ai.summaryEmpty: A short summary of the description and the discussion, for whoever picks it up.

ai.fromTextHelp: Paste a customer email, a chat message or notes. AI drafts the title, description, priority and labels, and you review it before creating.

customers.title: Customer requests
customers.empty: No customer has asked for this yet.
customers.orName: Not in the CRM? Type a name or an email: an email is matched to its company by domain.
customers.missingCustomer: Pick a customer or type a name.
customers.invalidEmail: That email does not look right.
customers.invalidUrl: The link must start with https://.
customers.pageSubtitle: Who asked for what, from the customer requests linked to issues. Revenue comes from won deals in the CRM.
customers.pageEmptyBody: Add a request from an issue or from a CRM company, or send one through the API (email, forms, Flow).
customers.crmEmpty: This customer has not asked for anything in Track yet.
customers.issueNotFound: No issue with that ID in this workspace.

agents.label: Agent
agents.noAgents: No agents yet. Create one in Agents or connect an external agent in Track settings.
agents.replyPlaceholder: Ask for more or give instructions
agents.history: {count, plural, one {# earlier session} other {# earlier sessions}}
agents.settingsHelp: When someone delegates an issue to an external agent, it receives a signed webhook (AgentSessionEvent: created or prompted) and answers through the API with its token. Agents from the Agents app show up in the issue without setup.
agents.name: Name
agents.created: {name} is connected. Copy the token and the signing secret now: they are not shown again.
agents.deleteBody: Its open sessions stop and its token stops working.
agents.invalidUrl: That webhook URL is not reachable from the internet.
agents.adminOnly: Only an admin can connect agents.
agents.docs1: The webhook body has action (created or prompted), agentSession with the issue, agentActivity (the person's message) and promptContext. Answer within seconds with a thought, then post your work:
agents.docs2: The session state follows your last activity: thought or action means working, elicitation waits for the person, response finishes it, error marks it failed.

settings.loadError: Could not load the triage settings.
settings.adminOnly: Only an admin can change these settings.
settings.ownerHelp: One person on duty takes the triage queue, rotating daily or weekly in this order.

ownerActions.assign: Assign it to the person on duty

settings.slaHelp: Each open issue with a priority that has an SLA gets a deadline. Subscribers and the assignee are notified when it is at risk and when it is breached.
settings.aiHelp: For issues in triage, AI suggests an assignee, labels, a priority and possible duplicates based on past issues. Choose what to suggest and what to apply on its own.

rules.title: Triage rules
rules.help: Rules run from top to bottom when an issue enters triage. If two rules set the same property, the higher one wins; labels add up.
rules.name: Name
rules.conditionsHelp: All conditions must match. A condition with several values matches any of them.
rules.missingAction: Choose at least one thing for the rule to do.

notifications.sla_risk: The SLA of {identifier} is at risk
